content: CSV injection (formula injection): OWASP-documented risk when exporting user-controlled text fields (razao_social, contato, observacao) to CSV/Excel. Cells starting with =,+,-,@ can be interpreted as formulas by Excel, enabling data exfiltration or command execution via DDE. Prevention: prefix any cell value starting with those chars with a leading apostrophe/single-quote or tab char to force text interpretation, strip control chars, and properly escape delimiter/quote chars.
